$Comment: Cogling (wave): the Cogling that a coupling room's hatches send up (W3, E4, N5; kit/machines.mjs coglingHatch). It is the same beetle, but it notices the players at once (round 6, Gibson note 6: wave Coglings sat in the corners until you came close; the room is 25 blocks across and the base Cogling sees 12 and hears 8). This is the pattern of the Feastmaster's arena adds (Dungeon_Feastmaster_Scrapper: 'detects all round', ViewRange 30, ViewSector 360, AlertedRange 60): it sees 40 all round and hears 24, and once alerted it keeps its target to 60. Everything else is the Cogling's.
